reviews.title: Poor Customer Service
reviews.text: Couldn't get my DayPack to fit in the tiny space under the seat in front of me. The flight attendant had me move and buckled my pack into the seat next to me. I had my eyes shut, then opened them to find the flight attendant was passing out fluids but had skipped me. I waited to see if she would return but gave up and pressed the call light. When I told her she skipped me, she argued with me saying I was asleep. She should have apologized for missing me instead and simply brought my drink. I dont think any other attendant has argued with me on my numerous flights.
reviews.author: NatureExplorerGal

reviews.title: They cancelled our flight at the. very last minute, almost a year later they haven't refunded my money
reviews.text: I booked a flight with this company on June 30, 2022 to travel on September 9. On August 23 I was notified with no further explanation that the flight had been cancelled. On September 9 I got a message asking me if I was going to take the flight, a moot point since I had already made other arrangements. Starting September 1st I had started seeking reimbursement. I won't get into all the details, calls, messages, emails, suffice to say that as of today, April of 2023, they have not replied with a concrete answer nor have they refunded my money. I wanted to give them the benefit of the doubt but as a last resort, I just called my bank and filed a claim to have the funds reimbursed. Very unprofessional and unreliable. If you are planning to travel between Roatan and Utila, use the ferry instead!
reviews.author: Claude1003

reviews.title: Scary
reviews.text: They put you on a small twin motor unit really like if you are on a plane like Indiana Jones was in one of his movies, noisy, seats like if you are ready to jump out on a parachute, got ears crunched after landing, if I have the opportunity I would never ride on this plane again. They have better air 'crafts to offer.
reviews.author: Marlon O

reviews.title: Tiny private plane, no safety measures
reviews.text: The plane was tiny, no air hostess, no air conditioner, no explanation of safety measures (not even seatbelt fastening). It didn't seem a commercial plane. Never flying with this airline again, and that's what we paid for.
reviews.author: Ana Lucia C

reviews.title: Such bad attendants! Fire a guy called Danilo!
reviews.text: The company has decent aircrafts and it's on time in most of the occasions. But it's because of the behavior of employees like DANILO of the Tegucigalpa Airport and others like a bad mood flight attendant that you should choose ANOTHER air company.
reviews.author: gabriel av

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: It was coronavirus lockdown. The govt was lost about what to do and the most official communication was that every tourist who didn't leave the island by August 4th would be charged fees for overstay. So I booked my flights to get home. First I booked MIA-->GRU as it was the pre-condition for all the other flights (US only accepting people on connecting flights). Well, I had an issue with the website and it took me 1 day and a half to be able to finally book it. In the meantime, though, I had my seat 'blocked' with Diunsa for the flight SAP-->MIA and, supposedly, also with CM for the leg RTB-->SAP. When I accessed the link that Victoria, the attendant from CM, sent me for payment, I realized it was 20 dollars more expensive so I asked her to check. No answer for the rest of the day. The next morning, then, I sent her a reminder, who told me that actually the flight was fully booked and the seat that she supposedly had guaranteed for me, had been sold to someone else. As those flights were not commercial and not many people were flying in and out, I had to take it with Lanhsa instead, 4 days earlier, and spend all that time with no support at all in San Pedro Sula.
reviews.author: Cê Otuski

reviews.title: Good Option with Excelent Rates
reviews.text: Is a very good local airline with excellent rates with the best options of hours. I recommend this airline to move specially form San Pedro Sula to Tegucigalpa to the Bay Islands.
reviews.author: Claudio Roberto S

reviews.title: The worst airline ever and they only have corruptive people working for them
reviews.text: I got an argument with one of the workers at the airport and they didn't let me fly that day, so they make me purchase another ticket for the following day and don't let me get on!!!!!!! They made me waste my money, just to tell me it's non-refundable. Not ever did they say that when they sold it or had me sign anything that says that!!!! THIEVES !!!!!! I called the airline and they refused to hand the phone to a manager!!!!! I would love for a damn owner to read this review and maybe show his damn face !!!!!! I only put one fu**** because I had too for this damn review!!!!
reviews.author: Mary O

reviews.title: Great airline
reviews.text: Had doubts about CM prior to my first trip. Awesome airline and experience. Safety is a priority and the pilots are well-trained and they have a sophisticated, professional ground crew. Aircraft while not new, are well maintained and provide a pleasant flight experience. The cost between TGU <> RTB is very affordable and flight are both ends were not only on time, but arrived early. Checkin is a breeze and there's open seating. Highly recommend CM Airlines.
reviews.author: DLJ

reviews.title: A short hop between the Bay Islands in Honduras
reviews.text: A small airplane ride of about 20 minutes to Utila, Honduras. The plane was small but well maintained. It was a twin prop 20 passenger plane. We flew the same type of planes in Fiji. CM's planes were better maintained. The flight was uneventful, exactly what you want on a island hop. I had no concerns on the flight to Utila or the flight back to Roatan 7 days later. Reasonable priced flight.
reviews.author: Martin W

reviews.title: Dated Plane & Slow Check In
reviews.text: This plane seemed very outdated. The seats were horrible, leaning every which direction. There was no air circulation or fans. It's do able because of the short flight. Last year Avianca had this route & we would rate it like first class, compared to these CM flights this year.
reviews.author: Ellen E

reviews.title: CM Airlines is fast and easy.
reviews.text: We organized a small group of 15 scuba divers to travel from Roatan to Utila Honduras. Our options were to take a ferry or fly. Debbie at Roatan Charter suggested we keep our group together and use CM Airline. It worked out great. CM Airline was a fast and easy way to get from Roatan to Utila Honduras. We flew in a small puddle jumper plane like you would expect to see around other small Caribbean Islands. Seats are all the same size, no food, no drinks, no entertainment, just a no-nonsense way of efficient travel around the Bay Islands.
reviews.author: Divepointcarrie

reviews.title: Fast. Easy. Comfortable.
reviews.text: A small airline, with simple and comfortable planes. On schedule and helpful to the very last. Easy and quick way to get to Utila.
reviews.author: larses_12

reviews.title: VERY helpful; VERY accommodating
reviews.text: Reliable and helpful. When one of us left a telephone in the Roatan airport, CM employees in San Pedro Sula phoned the Roatan counter, and they went out of their way to retrieve the phone. When one of our flights was delayed, they kept us informed about the situation, unlike, for example, American Airlines. For flights to/from Roatan and the mainland, I definitely recommend CM.
reviews.author: omisamoyed

reviews.title: Scary, but okay
reviews.text: A very scary experience, but a nice solution between Roatan and Tegucigalpa. Am I glad it's over? Yes. Would I try this again? I have no idea...
reviews.author: Norwegian Dane

reviews.title: on time, professional and friendly
reviews.text: I was a bit leery as I was not familiar with this airline but they were great. On time, professional and friendly. Great check in, quick and easy boarding. The baggage came off quick and they even helped us get our luggage to our connecting airline. They use small aircraft on this route, so if you are phobic about small planes you might want another option but our ride was very smooth and it's a fast flight. I would recommend this company!
reviews.author: Lisa L

reviews.title: To Roatan
reviews.text: Very good and friendly staff. I highly recommend to get to Roatan from/to San Pedro Sula or Tegucigalpa. Safe and fast
reviews.author: valverdejc2015
